current.sourceTitle: Synthetic integration fixture: website access for automated assistants

docs.title: Synthetic integration fixture: website access for automated assistants
docs.text: This is fictional test material, not a report about a real company or product. An automated assistant can help a user navigate a website, but the website may require a human to approve an action before it continues. The example team is designing a permission screen that explains which action the assistant wants to take. The user can decline the request and the assistant must stop without changing the account. The team also records the result of an action so that a failed connection does not cause the same action to run again. The design does not claim measured performance or accuracy. Reviewers still need to compare every proposed action with the user's original request and the website's rules. The illustration is a conceptual diagram and does not represent an actual product interface.

draft.title: 자동 비서의 웹 작업에는 사용자 확인이 필요해요
draft.summary: 가상의 테스트 사례에서는 자동 비서가 웹사이트를 탐색하더라도 실행 전에 사용자에게 확인을 받도록 설계합니다. 사용자가 거절하면 작업을 중단하고, 실행 결과를 기록해 연결 실패로 같은 작업이 반복되지 않도록 합니다.

plan.sequenceReason: 권한 확인부터 실행 결과 기록까지 순서대로 설명합니다.
